goal: Policy exception register: every departure from a policy recorded with its reason, owner and expiry.
use: Policy exception register: every departure from a policy recorded with its reason, owner and expiry. Use when a team cannot meet a policy requirement.

steps.note: List the exceptions. Each departure from policy, with the policy it breaks.
Check the reason. Each needs a stated reason.
Check the owner and expiry. Each needs an owner and an end date.
Check the approval. Each needs an approver above the team.
Report. The register, the expired exceptions and those for renewal.
